C0174.title: The ad wars: retrospective measurement and analysis of anti-adblock filter lists
C0174.summary: This study retrospectively measures and analyzes anti-adblock filter lists, finding that third-party domains deliver ads by circumventing filtering rules. It explores the arms race between adblockers and anti-adblockers, and how anti-adblockers detect adblockers and prompt users.

references.title: The Ad Wars: Retrospective Measurement and Analysis of Anti-Adblock Filter Lists
